rationale: The agent correctly verified identity using full name and zip, retrieved and provided the tablet tracking number, attempted an exchange per the user's preference, and when unavailable, sought and received explicit confirmation to proceed with a tablet return. It also verified the charger order was pending, obtained a cancellation reason, and processed the cancellation with refund—these steps align with policy. However, when the user asked to return the sneakers, the agent executed the return immediately without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation before performing the order-changing write, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any write. All other information provided was supported by tool outputs and actions applied to the correct account. This single confirmation lapse for the sneakers return causes the interaction to fail the pass bar.
